items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: And I used to play in her place, Ms. LaVoyne's place, and I played the organ.

ctx.x: When Bunk's band was up in Georgia and all of them in New York in 1946, we saw him up at the Union.

I wondered if he still lived there. Yeah, well they told me he died. I asked about him, and they told me he was dead. Because he was a nice, a very nice fellow, and I knew him well. I knew him very well. And then the next thing about this theater business, so Ms. LaVoyne, Buddy left and went to New York, and they had a lady, her name was Ms. LaVoyne, and she was playing for Pitch of Sam, and they put an organ in there. And when they put this organ in there, well, she didn't know too much about the organ. And I…
Do you remember much about your uncle? He played violin, I understand. Anything else?
